1.q: I have 1.3 crore. Should I take a 2BHK ready to move in Noida or a 3BHK under construction in Greater Noida West?
1.text:
Finished


For most end-users, take the 2BHK ready-to-move in Noida if you need to live in it soon, value certainty, and want to avoid construction/delivery risk. Choose the 3BHK under construction in Greater Noida West only if you can comfortably fund the full cost plus GST, stamp duty, registration, and 2–4 years of rent/EMI—and the builder, RERA record, and possession date are strong.
crcgroup
+1

Why ready-to-move often wins

A ready 2BHK lets you inspect the actual flat, society, water supply, lifts, and maintenance before committing; it also removes possession delay risk. Ready flats with an occupancy certificate attract no GST, while under-construction homes generally do, and you also need to budget for stamp duty and registration.
crcgroup
+1

With ₹1.3 crore, a Noida 2BHK can likely be bought with a manageable loan and lower carrying costs. A 3BHK under construction may look affordable at booking, but the real cost includes GST, escalating maintenance, rent during the construction period, and the risk of delayed possession.
prateekgroup

When the 3BHK makes sense

Greater Noida West offers better space per rupee: recent market estimates place mid-segment 2BHKs around ₹75–95 lakh and 3BHKs around ₹1.1–1.5 crore, so a ₹1.3 crore 3BHK is plausible in the right project.
synergyinfracon
+1

Take it if all of these apply:

You need the third room for children, parents, a home office, or frequent guests.
crcgroup

You will not need to move in for at least 2–3 years.

The builder has a credible delivery record and the project is RERA-registered with a realistic completion date.
crcgroup
+1

Your total outgo—basic price, GST, stamp duty, registration, parking, brokerage, furnishing, and interim rent—fits within your finances, not merely the quoted ₹1.3 crore.
prateekgroup

You have an emergency fund and can handle EMI plus rent if possession slips.

Decision framework
Factor	2BHK ready, Noida	3BHK under construction, GN West
Move-in	Immediate	Usually 2–4 years or later
Certainty	High; inspect before purchase	Depends on builder and RERA progress
Space	Lower	Higher
Cost certainty	Higher	GST and delay-related costs can raise total cost 
prateekgroup

Location maturity	Usually better if in established Noida sectors	Often newer infrastructure; verify actual connectivity
Best for	End-user needing a home now	Family needing space and able to wait
My recommendation

Buy the 2BHK ready-to-move if this is your primary residence, you want to stop paying rent, or your family needs stability now.

Buy the 3BHK under construction only if it is from a top-tier developer, the price is genuinely all-in under ₹1.3 crore, possession is within about 2–3 years, and you can afford rent plus EMI until then. Greater Noida West has a history of delivery delays among smaller builders, so developer quality matters more than the headline price.
synergyinfracon

Before signing either deal, verify the exact carpet area against the agreement, check the project/promoter on the UP RERA portal, inspect the society on both a weekday and weekend, and confirm occupancy certificate, maintenance charges, and water supply.
crcgroup
